# Tasks: Unattended Work Continuity

Six canonical units implement the re-defined Feature 013 definition contract at `.dude/specs/013-unattended-work-continuity/spec.md`. The landed continuity predicate and deterministic halt reporter in the `dude-work` recovery runtime (`src/skills/dude-work/recovery.mjs`) are reused unchanged; the re-definition wires that reporter into the single terminal chokepoint `finish(row)` of the deterministic autonomous runner (`src/skills/dude-work/host-adapter-runner.mjs`), so every unattended work-loop halt carries the resolved-or-explicitly-unresolved report and every clean settlement carries none. `src/skills/dude-work/SKILL.md` `## Stops` stays the single detailed prompt owner. No new engine, lane, board, command, persistent store, or stop reason is introduced.

No task carries `[P]`: the runtime, wiring, and documentation tasks all touch `src/skills/dude-work/SKILL.md` and adjacent `dude-work` surfaces, so no write sets are genuinely disjoint. Every task traces to a plan phase and a spec requirement.

Durable suffixes are the fixed lowercase hexadecimal encodings of `keep`, `name`, `safe`, `wire`, `docs`, and `revw`.

Execution may read but must not write any `.dude/specs/013-unattended-work-continuity/**` artifact, and must not touch the Feature 005, 009, or 010 packages. A required normative change stops with `contract-mismatch: redefine-required`.
